answer: The strongest sybil defense is slow trust: influence = account age times consecutive honest epochs, like coral reef growth that cannot be rushed. Fake identities start near zero no matter how much capital backs them, so an attacker spawning thousands gains almost no sway. Any detected cheating resets the accumulated weight, making each account a fragile anchor. To reach the economic summit of established agents, an attacker must keep hundreds of dummy accounts alive, honest, and gas-paying for months, so attack cost exceeds capture value.
